LanguageData.LP_GenasiCore.label: elemental bloodline
LanguageData.LP_GenasiCore.description: A bloodline left by an ancestor who joined with an elemental being. Anyone with this gene counts as a genasi; the bloodline's specific power comes from another "elemental bloodline" gene (one of blaze, tide, stone, gale).
LanguageData.LP_GenasiCore.customEffectDescriptions.0: Counts as a genasi (racial relations, faction goodwill, elemental charm crafting).
LanguageData.LP_ElementFire.label: blaze bloodline
LanguageData.LP_ElementFire.description: The bloodline of elemental fire. Carriers can't be ignited and take half fire damage (not immune); heat-tolerant but cold-sensitive. Can use "Spark" to ignite a target within 6 cells.
LanguageData.LP_ElementWater.label: tide bloodline
LanguageData.LP_ElementWater.description: The bloodline of elemental water. Carriers aren't slowed by shallow water, marsh and shallow ocean, and pathfinding no longer avoids water; more cold-tolerant than others. Can use "Water stream" to put out fires in a 3×3 area at the target and drench enemies in it (move speed ×80%, 10 seconds).
LanguageData.LP_ElementWater.customEffectDescriptions: Moving in water: no slowdown in shallow water, marsh and shallow ocean (deep water is still impassable).
LanguageData.LP_ElementEarth.label: stone bloodline
LanguageData.LP_ElementEarth.description: The bloodline of elemental earth. Carriers get mining speed ×130%, mining yield +10%, and skin as resistant to blunt blows as rock (blunt armor +15%), but walk a little slower. No active ability.
LanguageData.LP_ElementAir.label: gale bloodline
LanguageData.LP_ElementAir.description: The bloodline of elemental air. Carriers get move speed ×110% and can "wind leap" on the wind to a visible standable spot within 8 cells (can't pass through walls, costs no psyfocus).
LanguageData.LP_SkinEmber.label: ember skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinEmber.description: A fire genasi's ochre-red skin, the color of dying embers.
LanguageData.LP_SkinTide.label: tide skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinTide.description: A water genasi's blue-green skin with a sheen like the water's surface.
LanguageData.LP_SkinStone.label: rock skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinStone.description: An earth genasi's grey-brown skin, like weathered sandstone.
LanguageData.LP_SkinSky.label: sky skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinSky.description: An air genasi's pale grey-blue skin, like an overcast sky.
